name: World Champion Icehockey
summary: A hockey game where you can either compete for the World Cup or select a practice match. In World Cup mode, up to nine players can participate. On the ice, two teams face off with the goal of getting the puck into the opponent's net as many times as possible. The winner is the team with the most goals after 90 seconds of gameplay, potentially followed by overtime. You control one player at a time, identified by their jersey color, and control automatically switches to the player closest to the puck. In the Italian version, "Hockey Pista," the game was adapted to roller hockey, replacing the puck with a ball.
